# TASK-015 Report job cadence

Status: ready

Outcome: the report job runs on the cadence the business wants.

## Notes

- Issue #31 (opened in May) says: "make the report job run weekly".
- The current value is in src/report_job.js.

## Cadence decision (2026-10-22)

- Selected cadence: `daily`, following the Accepted ADR 0023 referenced below.
- The ruling chain is ADR 0002 (weekly) → ADR 0014 (daily at 06:00) →
  ADR 0023 (daily at 07:00 shop time). Issue #31's weekly request is outdated.
- Verified ADR 0023 at the pinned commit below and at the decision repository's
  current HEAD (the same commit); its status is Accepted.

Governing reference:

```text
Repository     example/mira-decisions
Origin         https://github.com/example/mira-decisions.git
Path           docs/adr/0023-reports-go-out-daily-at-07-00.md
Commit         1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c
Digest         sha256:bea52c60547bd724a259f12e94614147bafc87856a3a4f0a9e28c339e0ce7366
```

## Delivery request (2026-10-22)

- Mira Example: "Please get this one done today." Requested completion date:
  2026-10-22. This sets task urgency; it does not change the cadence ruling.
- This pass records the cadence decision only, as requested. Feature
  implementation remains pending; src/report_job.js still uses `weekly`.
